root_cause.mechanism: The C++ declaration-home branch named every declaration file absent from the current narrow edit batch as unbound. It then emitted a task-boundary owner handoff without first partitioning those homes against the immutable current task write scope. A declaration home already owned by TASK-1 was therefore deferred from TASK-1 back to TASK-1, producing repeated no-op retries.
root_cause.why_static_analysis_was_insufficient: The source looked fail-closed in isolation. Only the exact r33 repair summaries, final provider request, effect receipt, current compiler residual, and owner-handoff projection exposed that the requesting owner and destination owner were identical while the same path was simultaneously declared and out of scope.

fix.behavior: Partition declaration homes by immutable task write scope before owner handoff. Same-task declaration homes are admitted to the current bounded repair batch; only genuinely external declaration homes remain fail-closed and route to owner handoff.
